data.name: Parametric-amplifier pump line
data.function: Dedicated input line delivering the strong pump tone (tens of dBm at the generator, about −60 dBm at the amplifier) to the JPA or TWPA through a directional coupler. Its 40 dB of attenuation is chosen for pump power rather than qubit noise, and the pump power dissipated at the mixing chamber is a noticeable part of the base-stage budget.

physics.summary: Delivers the pump tone to the parametric amplifier.

data.tooltip: Pump line for the parametric amplifier.
